racing.label: RACING
racing.heading: Hyper Racing
racing.subtitle:
The galaxy's most intense flying vehicle racing experience,
where skill rules, and champions are made.
intro: Hyper Racing is a proposed high-octane competitive racing game, in development and set across alien worlds, where players may be able to build, upgrade, and pilot fully customisable flying race vehicles through some of the most dangerous circuits in the galaxy. From proposed floating rock formations and volcanic lava tubes to desert wastelands and mountain passes, every proposed race is planned as a test of preparation, reflexes, and strategy.

Hyper Racing is planned as a competitive platform. Top performers may be able to enter ranked events and tournaments with in-game rewards on the line. Whether you are chasing leaderboard glory or building a racing empire, everything you do in Hyper Racing may move you forward.

In the planned games under development, you may be able to:
• Upgrade your race vehicles from nose to tail
• Gain and level up your pit crew
• Acquire a pit manager who matches your racing philosophy
• Take your skills beyond the track, with a racing garage that doubles as the hangar of your personal spaceship
• Carry the abilities you develop into space combat across Hyper Quest and Overlord of the 7 Realms
racing.introClose: Read on to discover how the proposed game is planned to work, the in-game rewards it may offer, and how your racing career could fuel an entire universe of progression. All subject to the games being finalised and to the final game rules.
racing.calloutLine1: Race to Improve. Improve to Upgrade.
racing.howItWorksTitle: How the Proposed Hyper Tek Racing Games that are in development are planned to work: the overview is below, subject to games being finalised and final game rules.

howItWorks.title: Choose Your Vehicle
howItWorks.body: Every race begins in your garage. Pick from a growing roster of flying race vehicles, each with unique handling characteristics and upgrade potential. Strip a hull down for blistering straight-line speed or armour it up to survive the most brutal conditions. Thrusters, stabilisers, shields, cooling systems, aerodynamic fins, the upgrade tree runs deep, and every modification changes how your craft behaves on the track.

howItWorks.title: Build Your Team
howItWorks.body: Racing is a team sport. Acquire pit crew specialists who bring unique bonuses, faster refuelling, real-time diagnostics, emergency mid-race hull repairs, and between-lap performance tweaks. Each crew member levels up with experience, stacking powerful abilities on top of your vehicle upgrades. Then acquire a pit manager to coordinate operations, call race strategy, and unlock team-wide performance boosts that compound over a full season.

howItWorks.title: Race Across Worlds
howItWorks.body: Circuits span alien planets with wildly different terrain and atmospheric hazards. Weave through Avatar-style floating rock formations, thread volcanic lava tubes at breakneck speed, tear across endless desert plains, and carve through treacherous mountain ranges. Acid rain, radioactive atmospheres, shifting gravity, and turbulent winds, no two races demand the same setup. Tuning your vehicle to match each environment is where strategy meets skill.

howItWorks.title: Climb the Ranks
howItWorks.body: Victory gives leader points, unlocks new circuits on distant worlds, and opens the door to higher-tier competitions. The deeper you go, the fiercer the opponents and the greater the stakes. Prove yourself across every planet and rise through the global rankings.

rewards.title: In-Game Rewards With In-Game Items
rewards.body: Every race you finish is planned to give you in-game rewards. Win, and the in-game rewards may multiply. Race victories may unlock premium vehicle components, rare upgrade materials, exclusive in-game crew tokens, and in-game credits for your next build. You may be able to upgrade your vehicles and trade them with other players, subject to the final game rules.

rewards.title: Ranked Events
rewards.body: Hyper Racing is planned around ranked events and tournaments. Proposed skill-based competitions may let you prove your ability against the best pilots in the galaxy for in-game rewards, titles and leaderboard standing. From weekly ranked challenges to seasonal championship events, top performers may find plenty of chances to stand out.

rewards.title: How In-Game Reward Events May Work
rewards.body: Players may qualify through ranked play by meeting performance thresholds. Events are planned around fair matchmaking, so every competitor may face opponents of similar skill. Event rules and in-game rewards are intended to be shown clearly before you commit, subject to the final game rules.

rewards.title: Progression Beyond the Track
rewards.body: In-game rewards gained through racing are planned to feed into your broader progression. You may be able to upgrade your race vehicles, strengthen your pit crew, and put in-game rewards into upgrading your main spaceship. Your racing garage is designed to be the hangar bay of that ship, so improvements to your racing operation may also power up the vessel you fly between worlds in Hyper Quest and Overlord of the 7 Realms.

racing.upgradesTitle: Two Machines, One Mission... Upgrade Everything

upgrades.title: Racing Vehicle Upgrades
upgrades.body: The proposed race vehicles under development are planned to be a fully modular machine. Every component can be swapped, tuned, and upgraded: hulls, thrusters, shields, outer shells, engines, stabilisers, cooling systems, and aerodynamic surfaces. Lightweight composites deliver raw speed; heavy-duty armour keeps you alive through brutal atmospheric conditions. The upgrade path is deep, and the choices you make define your racing identity. Collect new vehicles, build them into championship contenders, race them to victory, and trade them with other players when you are ready for the next challenge, all subject to the final game rules.

upgrades.title: Main Spaceship Upgrades
upgrades.body: Your planned racing garage may not just be a workshop. It is designed to be the hangar bay of your personal spaceship. The same resources, credits, and materials you gain on the track can be put into upgrading your main vessel. Better engines for interplanetary travel, stronger weapons systems for space combat, improved navigation for discovering new racing worlds, and reinforced hulls for surviving hostile encounters during transit. Your spaceship is your home base, your transport, your battleship, and racing makes it stronger, all subject to the final game rules.

upgrades.title: The Upgrade Loop
upgrades.body: Collect proposed in-game rewards, which may lead to upgrades to enter bigger races with greater in-game rewards. Funnel those rewards into both your racing vehicles and your spaceship. The better your ship, the further you travel and the more dangerous and rewarding the circuits become. It is a planned progression loop that rewards dedication and skill at every level, all subject to the final game rules.

upgrades.title: Cross-Game Impact
upgrades.body: Every proposed pilot skill you develop on the track and every upgrade you install on your spaceship carries directly into Hyper Quest and Overlord of the 7 Realms. One universe, multiple games, seamless progression. What you build in Hyper Racing powers everything else, all subject to the final game rules.

faq.q: What is Hyper Racing?
faq.a: A proposed high-intensity flying vehicle racing game, in development and set across alien worlds. Players may be able to build, upgrade, and race fully customisable vehicles through hazardous sci-fi circuits while competing for in-game rewards.

faq.q: Can I upgrade my race vehicle?
faq.a: Every component is proposed to be upgradeable: hulls, thrusters, shields, outer shells, engines, stabilisers, cooling systems, and aerodynamic surfaces. Each upgrade may change how your vehicle handles different tracks and conditions.

faq.q: What does the pit crew do?
faq.a: Proposed pit crew members may provide unique bonuses: faster refuelling, hull diagnostics, emergency repairs, and performance tweaks between laps. They are planned to level up over time, unlocking stronger abilities that stack with vehicle upgrades.

faq.q: How does the pit manager work?
faq.a: The planned pit manager may coordinate crew operations, call race strategy, and unlock team-wide performance boosts. Defensive managers may protect your vehicle in harsh conditions; aggressive managers may push every system for maximum speed.

faq.q: Are there prizes for ranked events?
faq.a: Proposed ranked events and tournaments are planned to offer in-game rewards, titles and leaderboard standing. They do not offer cash or money prizes.

faq.q: How do race rewards work?
faq.a: Every race is planned to reward with in-game rewards: in-game credits, upgrade materials, and in-game crew tokens. Victories may multiply your in-game rewards. This is a planned feature subject to the final game rules.

faq.q: Can I upgrade my main spaceship too?
faq.a: That is the plan. Your racing garage is designed to be the hangar bay of your spaceship. Racing in-game rewards may help upgrades to engines, weapons, navigation, and hull reinforcement on your main vessel.

faq.q: Does progress carry to other games?
faq.a: Proposed pilot skills and spaceship upgrades may transfer into Hyper Quest and Overlord of the 7 Realms. One universe, multiple planned games, shared progression, subject to the final game rules.

faq.q: What racing environments are there?
faq.a: Proposed circuits span floating rock formations, lava tubes, desert plains, and mountain ranges across alien worlds. Planned atmospheric hazards include acid rain, radioactive atmospheres, variable gravity, and turbulent winds. Each circuit may demand a different vehicle setup.

quest.label: QUEST
quest.heading: Hyper Quest
quest.subtitle: Your galaxy. Your rules. Your story.
intro: Hyper Quest is a proposed open-world space adventure where you may command your own fully upgradable spaceship, the Quest Racer, across a vast and dangerous galaxy. You left your home civilisation years ago in search of power and fame. Now the entire universe is your playground, and every quest you complete may bring you closer to galactic dominance, subject to final game development and game rules.

Hyper Quest is planned as more than a game: complete quests, conquer challenges, and collect in-game rewards. From quick missions that take minutes to epic multi-day expeditions, the harder the challenge, the bigger the in-game reward may be, subject to final game development and game rules.

In the planned game you may be able to upgrade your spaceship from hull to cockpit, arm it with devastating weapons systems, and acquire specialists who stack powerful bonuses onto your ship's performance and power level. Proposed activities include mining asteroids, hauling dangerous cargo, hunting hidden treasures, tracking high-value targets, or becoming a mercenary. How you rule the universe is planned to be your choice, subject to final game development and game rules.

Everything you build in Hyper Quest is planned to feed into Hyper Racing and Overlord of the 7 Realms. One universe, seamless progression, unlimited potential. Read on to discover how the proposed questing may work, what in-game rewards you may gain, and how you and your spaceship may become the most feared vessel in the galaxy, all subject to final game development and game rules.
quest.calloutLine1: Quest to Gain. Gain to Upgrade.
quest.howItWorksTitle: How the Proposed Hyper Quests May Work, Subject to Final Game Development and Game Rules

howItWorks.title: Accept Quests From the Mission Board
howItWorks.body: Missions may be accepted from the proposed in-game questing board. Planned missions range from quick cargo runs that take just minutes to epic multi-day expeditions deep into uncharted space. Each quest is planned to come with clear objectives, danger ratings, and in-game reward tiers. You may be able to pick the missions that match your playstyle, whether that is hauling dangerous cargo, hunting hidden treasures, mining asteroid fields, or going undercover to recover lost artefacts.

howItWorks.title: Explore the Galaxy
howItWorks.body: You may be able to travel through portals to distant planets, each with proposed unique environments, in-game materials, and new racing circuits. Planned galactic maps may let you chart unexplored regions and gain naming rights for planets you discover first. You may mine in-game resources from asteroid fields, recover parts from ancient relics and abandoned ships, and gather clues that lead to hidden in-game items scattered across the stars.

howItWorks.title: Build Your Empire From Within Your Ship
howItWorks.body: Your proposed Quest Racer is planned to be more than transport. You may be able to grow food in hydroponic bays, refine materials mined from distant planets, and build armies from within your cloning labs. A self-sustaining mobile base is planned that may grow more powerful with every mission you complete.

howItWorks.title: Play Your Way
howItWorks.body: There is no single planned path to dominance. You may be able to become a feared bounty hunter, a cunning smuggler, a master miner, or a legendary explorer, or forge alliances to control entire sectors. Every decision may shape your reputation, subject to the final game rules.

quest.rewardsTitle: Planned Quest In-Game Rewards and How They May Work

rewards.title: In-Game Rewards
rewards.body: Every quest you complete is planned to give you in-game rewards. In-game credits, upgrade materials, rare components, in-game specialist tokens, and exclusive in-game items may flow into your inventory with every successful mission. The harder the quest, the greater the in-game rewards may be.

rewards.title: Championship In-Game Rewards
rewards.body: Certain proposed quests and ranked challenges may offer premium in-game rewards. High-tier missions, leaderboard events and seasonal quest championships are planned, and the more skilled and daring you become, the better the in-game rewards may be.

rewards.title: How Quest In-Game Rewards May Work
rewards.body: Players may qualify for premium quests by building their reputation and meeting performance thresholds. Quest difficulty, duration, and danger level are planned to determine the in-game reward, which is intended to be shown before you accept any mission. Whether you are running a ten-minute cargo haul or a week-long deep-space expedition, the in-game rewards are designed to match the risk.

rewards.title: Progression That Carries Forward
rewards.body: Quest in-game rewards may feed into your ship upgrades, weapons systems, and specialists. Each in-game reward may make you stronger, which could unlock harder quests. Progress is also planned to carry across into Hyper Racing and Overlord of the 7 Realms, subject to the final game rules.

quest.upgradesTitle: Upgrade Your Ship, Arm Your Arsenal, Build Your Crew

upgrades.title: Proposed Spaceship Upgrades
upgrades.body: Your proposed Quest Racer is planned to be fully modular from engine bay to cockpit. You may be able to upgrade the hull for durability, reinforce the outer shell to withstand hostile environments, boost shield generators for combat survivability, and overhaul power systems for peak performance. Better engines may mean faster interplanetary travel, and stronger navigation systems may reveal hidden routes and uncharted worlds.

upgrades.title: Proposed Weapons Systems
upgrades.body: The planned galaxy is dangerous. You may be able to upgrade and refine your weapons systems to protect yourself against pirates, rival players, and hostile forces, choosing between defensive configurations and offensive loadouts. Laser arrays, missile batteries, plasma cannons, and experimental energy weapons are all proposed as you progress through the upgrade tree.

upgrades.title: Acquire Specialists
upgrades.body: Proposed specialists may each bring unique skills that add bonuses to your ship's overall performance and power level. Navigation specialists may reveal hidden paths and reduce travel time. Combat specialists may boost weapon accuracy and damage. Engineering specialists may increase hull integrity and repair speed. Science specialists may improve resource extraction and material refinement. Stacking multiple specialists is planned, subject to the final game rules.

upgrades.title: The Planned Power Loop
upgrades.body: Quest to gain, gain to upgrade, and upgrade to take on harder quests with greater in-game rewards. Proposed specialists may amplify every system on your ship. The stronger you become, the more of the galaxy may open up. Ship upgrades and specialist bonuses are also planned to carry into Hyper Racing and Overlord of the 7 Realms, subject to final development and game rules.

faq.q: What is Hyper Quest?
faq.a: A proposed open-world space adventure, in development, where you may command a fully upgradable spaceship across a vast galaxy. Planned activities include completing quests, exploring alien worlds, upgrading your ship, acquiring specialists, and collecting in-game rewards.

faq.q: How do quests work?
faq.a: Missions may be accepted from the proposed in-game questing board. Planned quests range from quick cargo runs taking just minutes to epic multi-day expeditions deep into uncharted space. Each quest is planned to show its objectives, danger rating, and in-game reward tier before you accept.

faq.q: What in-game rewards may quests offer?
faq.a: Every completed quest is planned to give in-game rewards or in-game items: in-game credits, upgrade materials, rare components, in-game specialist tokens, and exclusive in-game items. Harder and longer quests may offer greater in-game rewards.

faq.q: Can I upgrade my spaceship?
faq.a: Every system is proposed to be upgradeable: hull, outer shell, shield generators, power systems, engines, cockpit, and navigation. Better engines may mean faster travel, and upgraded navigation may reveal hidden routes and uncharted worlds.

faq.q: What weapons are available?
faq.a: Proposed weapons systems include laser arrays, missile batteries, plasma cannons, and experimental energy weapons. You may be able to choose defensive configurations for survival or offensive loadouts against pirates, rivals, and hostile forces.

faq.q: How do specialists work?
faq.a: Proposed specialists may be gained or acquired, each with unique skills that add bonuses to your ship's performance and power level. Navigation specialists may reveal hidden paths, combat specialists may boost weapon damage, engineering specialists may increase hull integrity, and science specialists may improve resource extraction.

faq.q: What types of quests are available?
faq.a: Proposed quest types include cargo transport, asteroid mining, treasure hunting, bounty hunting, artefact recovery, undercover operations, planetary exploration, pirate defence, and recovery missions. Quests are planned to range from quick ten-minute runs to multi-day deep-space expeditions.

faq.q: Can I discover new planets?
faq.a: That is planned. Galactic maps may lead you into uncharted regions and new worlds, and first discoverers may gain naming rights for the planets they find. New worlds are proposed to offer unique in-game materials, environments, and racing circuits.

faq.q: What can I do inside my ship?
faq.a: Your proposed Quest Racer is planned as a mobile base. You may be able to grow food in hydroponic bays, refine materials mined from distant planets, build and train armies in cloning labs, and upgrade weapons and defences.

faq.q: How does the galactic map work?
faq.a: The proposed galactic map is planned to guide your exploration. You may be able to upgrade your map to reveal new sectors, portal locations, and hidden quest zones, unlocking more dangerous regions of space as you explore further.

faq.q: Does my progress carry to other games?
faq.a: What you build in Hyper Quest is planned to carry into Hyper Racing and Overlord of the 7 Realms. Ship upgrades, specialist bonuses, combat skills, and in-game resources may all transfer, subject to final development and game rules.

faq.q: Can I play as a villain?
faq.a: That is proposed. You may be able to go undercover, track high-value targets, smuggle dangerous cargo, or raid other players. There is no single planned path to dominance, and every decision may shape your reputation.

overlord.label: OVERLORD
overlord.heading: Overlord of the 7 Realms
overlord.subtitle: Crash-land. Rebuild. Conquer. Become the Overlord.
intro: Overlord of the 7 Realms is a proposed tri-level battle strategy game, in development. In the planned story you venture through a portal into a parallel universe and crash-land on a hostile alien planet. Your ship is wrecked, your systems are failing, and the planet's creatures are already closing in. Survival is just the beginning. Dominance is the goal.

In the planned game you may be able to rebuild your ship from the wreckage up, clone and train armies in your onboard labs, and tame the planet's wildlife to create mounted cavalry. Combat is proposed across three battle dimensions: ground-to-ground against monsters and rival players, ground-to-space assaults on orbital or ground targets, and space-to-space warfare aboard the massive Battle Ring that orbits the planet.

Like Hyper Racing and Hyper Quest, Overlord is planned to feature real-time VR interaction and in-game rewards for completing events, quests, and proposed fortnightly invasions by the fearsome Hammerongs, the most powerful alien species in the story. Every fortnight they are planned to arrive to strip-mine the planet, and players may be able to challenge them for in-game bonuses and legendary in-game rewards.

You may be able to upgrade your spaceship, arm it with weapons, acquire specialists who amplify your power level, and forge alliances to control entire regions. What you build is planned to connect to Hyper Racing and Hyper Quest. Read on to discover how the proposed battle system may work, all subject to final development and game rules.
overlord.howItWorksTitle: The Proposed Tri-Level Battle System, Subject to Final Development and Game Rules

howItWorks.title: Ground-to-Ground Combat
howItWorks.body: The planet's surface is planned as a warzone. You may be able to deploy your cloned armies against hostile alien creatures, monstrous beasts, and rival players fighting for territory and in-game resources. Taming and training the planet's wildlife may create mounted cavalry units for your ground forces. Battles you win are planned to give in-game resources, territory, and reputation.

howItWorks.title: Ground-to-Space Assaults
howItWorks.body: This is a proposed dimension that few other games offer. You may be able to create specialised troop groups designed to launch attacks between the planet's surface and the orbital Battle Ring, striking at ships stationed in space from your ground position or coordinating combined assaults from above and below. This planned vertical battle layer is designed to make positioning across both ground and space decide the outcome.

howItWorks.title: Space-to-Space Warfare
howItWorks.body: You may be able to port your ship into orbit and land on the Battle Ring, a proposed massive orbital structure circling the planet. From there you may hunt for unshielded ships and vulnerable targets, and teleport troops into enemy vessels using specially developed boarding attacks. Space combat is planned to offer some of the greatest in-game rewards, subject to the final game rules.

howItWorks.title: Why Tri-Level May Change Everything
howItWorks.body: Most strategy games operate on a single plane. Overlord is proposed to operate on three. The planned ability to attack from ground to ground, ground to space, and space to space is designed to create a battlefield with real tactical depth, where skill matters more than brute force.

extraSection.title: The Proposed Battle Ring and VR Interaction

items.title: Landing on the Battle Ring
items.body: The Battle Ring is a proposed colossal orbital structure that circles the planet's system. When you port your ship into space, you may be able to dock on the Battle Ring to gain a strategic position. From there you may hunt for unshielded ships, launch boarding parties into rival vessels, and coordinate attacks on ground targets below, subject to final development and game rules.

items.title: Inside the Battle Ring
items.body: The Battle Ring is planned to be more than a docking platform. If you can work out how to breach its interior, hidden quests, in-game bonuses, and exclusive in-game rewards may await inside. The ring's interior is proposed as a labyrinth of corridors, chambers, and ancient technology, with quests and hunting missions planned within the ring itself.

items.title: Planned Real-Time VR Interaction
items.body: Like all of the proposed Hyper Tek games, Overlord of the 7 Realms is planned to support VR interaction in real time. You may be able to step inside your ship, walk the corridors of the Battle Ring, lead your troops into ground combat, and experience space warfare from the cockpit of your vessel, subject to final development.

items.title: What Is Proposed to Set It Apart
items.body: Overlord proposes to combine tri-level warfare, an explorable orbital battle station, real-time VR, and in-game rewards in a single experience. Together with ground combat, space warfare, and the planned interconnected Hyper Tek games, this is the experience we are developing, subject to final development and game rules.

overlord.upgradesTitle: Rebuild, Rearm, Reinforce; Power Up for War

upgrades.title: Proposed Spaceship Upgrades
upgrades.body: Your crashed ship is where it is all planned to begin. You may be able to rebuild it system by system, from the engine bay to the command deck. Every component is proposed to be upgradeable: hull reinforcement, structural integrity, outer shell composition, shield generators, power systems, and navigation arrays. In Overlord, you are planned to build not for speed but for battle.

upgrades.title: Proposed Weapons Systems and Tech Levels
upgrades.body: You may be able to upgrade and refine your weapons, skills and tech levels across all three battle levels: ground-based artillery for planetary warfare, anti-orbital batteries for ground-to-space assaults, and ship-mounted weapons arrays for space-to-space combat. Each proposed weapons system may be refined for specific tactical roles, subject to the final game rules.

upgrades.title: Acquire Specialists
upgrades.body: Proposed specialists are planned as the force multiplier and, combined with skill, may be what separates good players from Overlords. You may be able to acquire unique specialists who bring bonuses to your ship's overall performance and power level. Tactical specialists may improve troop deployment efficiency, engineering specialists may accelerate ship repairs and upgrades, weapons specialists may increase damage across all systems, and intelligence specialists may reveal enemy positions and weaknesses. Players who do not spend can be reassured that Hyper Tek was created to tackle issues within gaming. While stacking is planned, the proposed game mechanics are designed so that stacking is not a simple point-for-point system. It is planned to operate on a sliding scale so that raw power does not overshadow the importance of skill.

upgrades.title: Build Your Armies
upgrades.body: You may be able to clone troops within your ship's onboard cloning labs, then upgrade and refine them and their weapons. Taming and training the planet's wild creatures may create mounted beast cavalry, a proposed force that cannot be cloned or manufactured and must be gained through skill and patience. Army composition across ground, air, and space is planned to decide your dominance.

overlord.rewardsTitle: The Hammerongs, In-Game Rewards, and the Planned Hyper Tek Games

rewards.title: The Hammerongs: The Most Powerful Species in the Story
rewards.body: Every two weeks, the centre arena's force fields are planned to drop, and the Hammerongs arrive. In the story they are the strongest alien species in the universe, armed with technology far beyond anything players possess. Attacking the Hammerongs is proposed as the most dangerous challenge in Overlord, and those who succeed may receive in-game bonuses, legendary loot, rare upgrade materials, and exclusive in-game rewards, subject to the final game rules.

rewards.title: Daily Events, Quests, and Battle In-Game Rewards
rewards.body: Overlord is planned to give in-game rewards regularly. Proposed daily tasks may give in-game credits, upgrade materials, and progression bonuses. Special events may offer premium in-game rewards. Quests across the planet's surface and within the Battle Ring may give exclusive in-game loot, and exploring the surface may reveal hidden artefacts and in-game items.

rewards.title: Planned Connection to the Other Hyper Tek Games
rewards.body: Overlord of the 7 Realms is not planned to exist in isolation. It is proposed to be integrated into the Hyper Tek universe alongside Hyper Racing and Hyper Quest. In-game resources gained in Overlord may be usable across all three planned games, and ship upgrades, specialist bonuses, combat skills, and materials may flow between titles, subject to final development and game rules.

rewards.title: One Universe, Three Planned Games
rewards.body: Players who take part across all three proposed Hyper Tek games may build power faster and may access cross-game in-game rewards, drawing on a breadth of skills and in-game resources. All of this is planned and subject to final development and game rules.

overlord.faqTitle: Overlord of the 7 Realms — Frequently Asked Questions

faq.q: What is Overlord of the 7 Realms?
faq.a: A proposed tri-level battle strategy game, in development, where you crash-land on an alien planet, rebuild your ship, clone armies, and fight across three dimensions: ground-to-ground, ground-to-space, and space-to-space. Planned features include VR interaction, in-game rewards, and fortnightly Hammerong invasions.

faq.q: What is the tri-level battle system?
faq.a: Combat is proposed to operate across three levels: ground-to-ground against monsters and rival players, ground-to-space assaults targeting orbital ships, and space-to-space warfare on the Battle Ring. This planned approach is designed to create real tactical depth.

faq.q: What is the Battle Ring?
faq.a: A proposed massive orbital structure circling the planet. You may be able to land your ship on it to hunt unshielded targets, launch boarding parties into enemy vessels, and access hidden quests inside its interior.

faq.q: Can I upgrade my spaceship?
faq.a: Every system is proposed to be upgradeable from engine bay to command deck: hull, structure, outer shell, shield generators, power systems, and navigation. In Overlord you are planned to build for battle, not speed.

faq.q: How do specialists work?
faq.a: Proposed specialists may be gained or acquired, adding bonuses to your ship's performance and power level. Tactical, engineering, weapons, and intelligence specialists may each boost different systems, subject to the final game rules.

faq.q: Who are the Hammerongs?
faq.a: The most powerful alien species in the story. Every fortnight they are planned to arrive at the centre arena to strip-mine the planet's resources. Attacking them is proposed to be extremely dangerous, and players who succeed may receive in-game bonuses and legendary in-game loot.

faq.q: What in-game rewards may be offered?
faq.a: Proposed daily tasks, quests, battles, and events are planned to give in-game credits, upgrade materials, and progression bonuses. Special events and Hammerong invasions may offer premium and exclusive in-game rewards.

faq.q: Does Overlord support VR?
faq.a: VR is planned. Real-time VR interaction may let you walk your ship's corridors, explore the Battle Ring interior, lead troops into ground combat, and pilot your vessel in space warfare, subject to final development.

faq.q: How do I build my army?
faq.a: You may be able to clone troops in your ship's onboard labs, then upgrade and refine them and their weapons. For mounted cavalry, the plan is that you tame and train the planet's wild creatures, as animals cannot be cloned.

faq.q: Can I join an alliance?
faq.a: Alliances are proposed. You may go it alone or join an alliance that increases your power and helps you grow. Planned alliance features include shared in-game resources, coordinated attacks, and collective defence.

faq.q: Is Overlord linked to other Hyper Tek games?
faq.a: That is planned. In-game resources, ship upgrades, specialist bonuses, and combat skills are proposed to flow between Overlord, Hyper Racing, and Hyper Quest, subject to final development and game rules.

faq.q: What weapons are available?
faq.a: Proposed weapons include ground-based artillery, anti-orbital batteries, ship-mounted weapons arrays, and specialised boarding-action equipment. Each system may be refined for specific tactical roles.

faq.q: Can I explore the planet's surface?
faq.a: That is planned. The proposed planet has hidden in-game rewards, artefacts, in-game resources, and dangerous wildlife to tame, with alien creatures and monsters to battle.

locDescs.nav: Automated navigation beacon. Guides transit traffic through the central corridor.
locDescs.pion: Frontier exploration base. Marks the edge of the charted transit network.
locDescs.sig: High-orbit relay beacon. Uplinks to the Core Network every 6 minutes.
locDescs.orb: Zero-gravity materials research. Studies exotic matter behavior under void conditions.
locDescs.col: Early settlement colony. Population: 12,400. Agriculture and mining operations active.
locDescs.trd: Eastern trade hub. Junction point for cargo routes from sectors R01–R08.
locDescs.bio: Pharmaceutical and xenobiology research. Quarantine protocols in effect.
locDescs.expl: Forward scout base for unmapped regions. Last transmission: 3.2 standard days ago.
locDescs.asm: Modular spacecraft assembly. Produces 12 vessels per standard cycle.
locDescs.tech: Advanced tech R&D facility. Specializes in propulsion systems and AI cores.
locDescs.gas: Atmospheric gas harvesting from a dense nebula pocket. High radiation environment.
locDescs.ice: Cryo-comet resource extraction. Primary water source for eastern stations.

storeroom.title: Storeroom
storeroom.desc: Central storage hub for raw materials and harvested resources. Manages inventory distribution across mining and refinery operations.

mining_fs.title: Mining FS
mining_fs.desc: Forward starboard mining bay. Equipped with deep-core extraction arrays for mineral and ore collection in open space.

mining_fp.title: Mining FP
mining_fp.desc: Forward port mining bay. Mirrors the starboard unit, doubling extraction capacity during resource-rich field operations.

process_ref.title: Process Refinery
process_ref.desc: Converts raw ore and minerals into refined alloys. Critical for fuel synthesis and ship upgrade materials.

mining_rs.title: Mining RS
mining_rs.desc: Rear starboard mining unit. Angled at -45° for lateral field sweeps during slow-drift asteroid harvesting.

mining_rp.title: Mining RP
mining_rp.desc: Rear port mining unit. Works in tandem with RS bay to maximise rear-field resource extraction.

fuel_ref.title: Fuel Refinery
fuel_ref.desc: Processes refined alloys into propulsion-grade fuel. Supplies the main engine and emergency thruster reserves.

workshop.title: Workshop
workshop.desc: Ship maintenance and fabrication center. Handles component repairs, part manufacturing, and equipment upgrades.

racing.title: Racing Hangar
racing.desc: Dedicated bay housing racing drones and light craft. Supports Racing game mode deployment and pit-stop operations.

brig.title: Brig
brig.desc: Secure containment cell for prisoners and valuable cargo. Reinforced walls prevent unauthorized access or escape.

armory_ss.title: Armory SS
armory_ss.desc: Starboard-side weapons locker. Stores and maintains small arms, crew protection gear and personal defense systems.

armory_ps.title: Armory PS
armory_ps.desc: Port-side weapons locker. Mirrors the SS armory providing balanced loadout access across both sides of the vessel.

main_weapon.title: Main Weapon Heavy
main_weapon.desc: Primary heavy weapon emplacement. Houses the ship's most powerful offensive systems for large-scale combat engagements.

fwd_shield.title: Forward Shield Gen
fwd_shield.desc: Generates a protective energy barrier across the ship's bow. First line of defense against incoming projectiles and energy attacks.

fighter_fss.title: Fighter Bay FSS
fighter_fss.desc: Forward starboard bay housing compact fighter craft. Enables rapid deployment of escort fighters during combat and patrol missions.

fighter_fps.title: Fighter Bay FPS
fighter_fps.desc: Forward port fighter bay. Operates in tandem with FSS bay for coordinated fighter squadron launches.

fighter_rss.title: Fighter Bay RSS
fighter_rss.desc: Rear starboard nacelle fighter bay. Supports rearguard operations and pursuit interception scenarios.

fighter_rps.title: Fighter Bay RPS
fighter_rps.desc: Rear port nacelle fighter bay. Provides symmetrical rear-coverage for full defensive fighter deployment.

barracks_ss.title: Barracks SS
barracks_ss.desc: Starboard crew quarters for combat personnel. Houses soldiers, pilots and security teams with bunk systems and equipment lockers.

barracks_ps.title: Barracks PS
barracks_ps.desc: Port crew quarters. Identical layout to SS barracks ensuring equal crew distribution and rapid mobilisation from either side.

stables_ss.title: Stables SS
stables_ss.desc: Starboard biological bay. Houses alien mounts and bio-engineered creatures used in planetary surface operations.

stable_ps.title: Stable PS
stable_ps.desc: Port biological bay. Mirrors the SS stables for balanced creature load and symmetric weight distribution.

transporter.title: Transporter Bay
transporter.desc: Quantum-assisted personnel and cargo transport system. Enables rapid short-range teleportation to planetary surfaces or nearby vessels.

security.title: Security Station
security.desc: Ship-wide surveillance and threat response hub. Monitors all decks and coordinates internal security protocols.

weapons_ss.title: Weapons Systems SS
weapons_ss.desc: Starboard weapons management console. Controls targeting arrays, firing sequences and ammunition logistics for starboard armaments.

weapons_ps.title: Weapons Systems PS
weapons_ps.desc: Port weapons management console. Provides full independent control of all port-side weapon platforms.

power_plant.title: Power Plant
power_plant.desc: Core energy generation unit. Provides stable power output to all ship systems via circular plasma containment technology.

power_sys.title: Power Systems
power_sys.desc: Power distribution and regulation hub. Manages load balancing between weapons, shields, engines and life support systems.

energy_dist.title: Energy Distribution
energy_dist.desc: Secondary energy routing node. Ensures consistent power delivery to mid-ship and rear-section systems under high-demand conditions.

main_engine.title: Main Ship's Engine
main_engine.desc: Primary propulsion system powering all sub-light travel. Generates thrust via antimatter-catalyzed plasma jets.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.desc: Central navigation and helm control station. Manages course plotting, astrocartography and real-time positional tracking.

flight_deck.title: Flight Deck
flight_deck.desc: Main piloting station. Controls all flight operations including take-off, landing, orbital manoeuvres and emergency evasive actions.

weapons_off.title: Weapons Officer
weapons_off.desc: Tactical weapons command post. Coordinates offensive and defensive weapons fire under the direct command of the Weapons Officer.

comms_off.title: Comm's Officer
comms_off.desc: Communication and signal interception hub. Handles all inter-ship, alliance and planetary communications including encrypted channels.

capt_quarters.title: Captain's Quarters
capt_quarters.desc: Private quarters for the ship's commanding officer. Contains secure data terminals and private briefing facilities.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.desc: Crew nutrition and food preparation facility. Processes stored food resources and synthesises nutritional supplements for long-haul voyages.

mess_hall.title: Mess Hall
mess_hall.desc: Communal dining and recreation space. Serves as crew morale hub during downtime between combat and resource operations.

hydro_1.title: Hydroponics Cell 1
hydro_1.desc: Automated growing unit producing fresh food and medicinal plants. Reduces dependency on stored provisions for extended missions.

hydro_2.title: Hydroponics Cell 2
hydro_2.desc: Secondary hydroponics cell expanding crop variety and output. Supports crew nutrition and trade commodity production.

hydro_3.title: Hydroponics Cell 3
hydro_3.desc: Tertiary growing unit specialised in high-output staple crops. Provides baseline caloric supply for large crew complements.

hydro_4.title: Hydroponics Cell 4
hydro_4.desc: Medicinal and botanical research cell. Grows rare species used in medical treatment and alchemical synthesis.

hydro_5.title: Hydroponics Cell 5
hydro_5.desc: Exotic plant cultivation bay. Produces luxury goods and rare flora for trading on the marketplace.

hydro_6.title: Hydroponics Cell 6
hydro_6.desc: High-growth experimental cell. Tests new crop strains developed through genetic modification programs.

shield_main.title: Shield Gen Main
shield_main.desc: Primary multi-directional shield generator. Projects an energy barrier around the entire hull during combat situations.

power_relay1.title: Power Relay 1
power_relay1.desc: Upper-deck power relay junction. Routes energy from the power plant to forward weapons and shield arrays.

power_relay2.title: Power Relay 2
power_relay2.desc: Lower-deck power relay junction. Distributes power to engine nacelles and rear defensive systems.

hidden_st1.title: Hidden Storage 1
hidden_st1.desc: Concealed high-security vault. Stores classified cargo, valuable artefacts and contraband away from standard inventory scans.

hidden_st2.title: Hidden Storage 2
hidden_st2.desc: Secondary concealed vault. Additional secure space for mission-critical items requiring maximum discretion.

cargo_1.title: Cargo Hold 1
cargo_1.desc: Primary bulk cargo bay. Designed for large-volume resource transport including ores, refined metals and trade goods.

cargo_2.title: Cargo Hold 2
cargo_2.desc: Secondary cargo bay optimized for fragile or temperature-sensitive loads. Climate-controlled storage conditions.

cargo_3.title: Cargo Hold 3
cargo_3.desc: Tertiary cargo bay. Configurable layout supports mixed loads including vehicles, containers and oversized equipment.

war_council.title: War Council
war_council.desc: Strategic command chamber. Senior officer briefing table where battle plans, alliance strategies and campaign objectives are coordinated.

academy.title: Academy
academy.desc: Crew training and education facility. Enables skill advancement, specialisation unlocks and officer development programs.

science_lab.title: Science Lab
science_lab.desc: Research and development center. Conducts experiments in materials science, propulsion theory and alien technology analysis.

dna_lab.title: DNA Lab
dna_lab.desc: Genetic research facility. Develops biological enhancements for crew, creates new species variants and researches alien DNA samples.

cryostasis.title: Cryostasis
cryostasis.desc: Long-range voyage suspension system. Places crew in cryogenic stasis to preserve resources during multi-year deep-space journeys.

dna_chambers.title: DNA Chambers
dna_chambers.desc: Genetic modification bays. Applies researched DNA enhancements directly to crew members and biological units.

weapons_relay.title: Weapons Power Relay
weapons_relay.desc: Dedicated power management node for heavy weapons systems. Ensures stable energy supply during sustained combat engagements.

comms_tower.title: Comm's Tower
comms_tower.desc: Long-range deep-space communications array. Enables fleet-wide broadcasts, interstellar transmissions and alliance coordination across vast distances.

lithionites.notes: The Lithionites are a complex species, classified as mutagenic, metamorphic hybrids. They are distinguished by their hard, rough exoskeletons and unique crystallised fluidic inner structure. In terms of behavior, Lithionites are known for their aggressive nature and can be easily provoked into combat when threatened or challenged. Despite their fierce disposition, they are quite sociable among members of their own species, where they often engage in social bonding rituals, although they are typically wary of outsiders and may perceive them as threats and, or prey. Within their groups, Lithionites have a tendency to test their strength against one another, leading to competitive displays that can sometimes disrupt group cohesion and unity. This frequent rivalry, while integral to their culture, can result in internal conflicts. Their diet is diverse, encompassing both plant life and meat sources. Lithionites are skilled hunters and ruthless in capturing prey. Their lack of mercy during hunts showcases their survival instincts and emphasises their dominance in their ecosystem. Lithionites reside in caves or constructed rock shelters at the bases of mountainous regions and rocky plains. These environments not only provide them with ample resources but also serve as strategic vantage points for observing rival species or potential threats. Loyalty is a cornerstone of Lithionite culture; they are fiercely devoted to their kin and will mobilise to engage in warfare against other species to secure territory and valuable resources. This warrior spirit reflects their deep-rooted beliefs and values. Spiritually, Lithionites hold a profound connection to crystallised structures, considering them sacred. They engage in rituals that involve worshipping the light emitted from fire and the energies radiated by the crystals that surround them.

marmulus.notes: The Marmulus species are classified as mutagenic, metamorphic hybrids. These extraordinary beings are characterised by their hard, smooth exoskeletons and feature a unique, energised fluidic inner core. Marmulus are not just biologically advanced; they are also socially vibrant and incredibly outgoing. They express their sexuality openly, celebrating their identities through elaborate displays. Their diet is diverse, comprising both plant life and meat, reflecting their adaptability as a species. Marmulus have a keen appreciation for valuable items and wealth, often seeking out rare treasures. Over the centuries, they have developed impressive cities that stand as testaments to their intelligence and creativity, favouring locations in mountainous regions or areas characterised by hard stone, which provide their inspiration. The social structure of the Marmulus is deeply rooted in democratic values, fostering loyalty and camaraderie among its communities. They maintain a well-defined authority that ensures harmony within their society. Central to their culture is a belief in spiritual beings and the importance of structural alignment, guiding their interactions with both the physical and metaphysical worlds.

ophidians.notes: The Ophidians species are characterised by their unique snake-alien hybrid appearance. With smooth, scaly skin that glistens in vibrant dark arrays of colors. These creatures thrive in social settings, exhibiting a strong tendency to interact and bond with one another, although their demeanour towards outsiders is notably hostile. Their diet is diverse, encompassing both meat and plant-based foods, which supports their dynamic lifestyle. Ophidians are renowned for their deep social connections and affection, forming tight-knit communities where loyalty is paramount. When their territory is threatened, they display fierce protectiveness, and their readiness to engage in conflict can be easily provoked. Worshipping the sun is an integral part of their culture, as they flourish in warm to hot plains and arid regions. Their architectural prowess is evident in the advanced cities they construct in these sun-drenched environments, showcasing their engineering skills and adaptation to their preferred habitats.

geodians.notes: The Geodian species are classified as mutagenic metamorphic hybrids. These remarkable beings possess a striking crystalised lattice exoskeleton that shimmers and refracts light with mesmerising beauty, while their inner core flows with a fluidic substance that fluctuates with thermal energy. Intelligent and highly evolved, Geodians have established intricate cities, showcasing advanced engineering and architectural marvels that often flourish near thermal hot springs or regions of intense heat, where their unique biology thrives. Social in nature, Geodians embrace their communal existence, openly expressing their emotions and sexuality, fostering connections that bind them together. Their diet is versatile, comprising both lush plant life and various forms of meat, reflecting their adaptive nature. The Geodian society is marked by its democratic principles and well-structured systems, ensuring every voice is heard. They hold a deep reverence for light, which dances through their crystal lattice, creating a captivating spectacle that symbolises their spiritual beliefs and unity within the community.

fawnus.notes: The Fawnus species resembles a captivating blend of goat and alien features. Their bodies are covered in coarse, short hair that varies in color, giving them an intriguing appearance that reflects their playful personalities. Inherently mischievous and spirited, Fawnus are known for their love of play, often engaging in activities that showcase their vibrant energy. Their diet is impressively diverse, as they thrive on both meat and plant-based foods, allowing them to adapt in varying environments that support their dynamic lifestyles. Socially, Fawnus are deeply connected, forming tight-knit communities where loyalty holds significant value. Their bonds are fierce, and they display a protective instinct towards both their kin and their territory, making them guardians of the places they inhabit. Culturally, the Fawnus are devout, worshipping an array of gods and religious symbols that are integral to their way of life. They take cues from Spanish culture, revelling in the joy of music and the allure of wealth, particularly gold, which they cherish as a symbol of prosperity. Architecturally, their creations are nothing short of magnificent, showcasing a steampunk style that reflects both their artistic flair and engineering prowess. Grand structures adorned with intricate designs and mechanisms stand as a testament to their creativity and innovation.

mantaquads.notes: The Mantaquads are unique beings, characterised by their four dexterous arms and four observant eyes, embodying the essence of an alien hybrid. These creatures possess a hive mind, allowing them to operate in perfect unison, which makes them a formidable force. Social creatures by nature, Mantaquads engage in vibrant interactions and are known for their open and adventurous approach to sexuality. Their pursuit of perfection drives them to master a wide array of martial arts, honing their skills with relentless dedication. They consume both meat and plant-based foods, with a particular desire for hunting. Their hunting methods are both thrilling and ruthless, as they prefer to consume their prey while it is still alive, revelling in the primal act of pursuit. As mercenaries, the Mantaquads are often sought after for their unparalleled efficiency and merciless prowess in battle. Their hive minds enhance this capability, enabling them to function seamlessly as a single unit, whether in combat or construction. These beings exhibit remarkable architectural skills, erecting intricate and massive structures at a pace unmatched by any other species. Deeply religious, Mantaquads are devoted worshippers who follow an intriguing blend of medieval traditions and the use of satanic symbols. They demonstrate their faith by contributing at least 10% of their wealth to churches, reflecting their commitment to their beliefs and community.

dryads.notes: The Dryads are a fascinating and unique species, characterised by their hybrid nature that combines traits from plant and alien lifeforms. This distinctive physiology allows them to thrive in diverse environments, often resembling the flora around them. They have a hive-like mind, which enables them to communicate seamlessly with one another. This collective consciousness fosters a deep sense of unity and cooperation, allowing them to operate as a cohesive group while maintaining an intricate connection to the natural world, and they can sense the health of their surroundings, making them exceptional guardians of nature. Their diet is primarily plant-based, consisting of leaves, fruits, and other botanical materials. However, they occasionally supplement their diet with small quantities of meat, which they acquire with great care and respect for the life they take. In addition to their physical attributes, the Dryads are known for their playful and mischievous behavior. They often engage in light-hearted pranks or games, reflecting their joyful spirit. Their loyalty to one another and their homeland is unwavering, and they will fiercely protect their community and territory when threatened. Spiritually, the Dryads hold a profound belief in an afterlife that is intertwined with the cycles of nature. They revere the natural elements (Earth, Air, Fire, and Water) as divine forces, and they also worship celestial bodies such as the sun and stars, which they perceive as guiding lights in their existence. This deep connection to both nature and the cosmos shapes their culture, rituals, and overall way of life.
